decision_rule.rule_a: 如果当前 12h 主要仍是 R0 proxy / smoke_placeholder: 推荐 LP_LONG_HORIZON_R1_REAL_DATA_OBSERVATION_UPGRADE_V1
decision_rule.rule_b: 如果 12h 已经有真实 quote / fee / EV: 才允许推荐 24h

four_allowed_stages_evaluation.rationale: 12h 主要仍是 r0 proxy, spec 规则 '推荐 R1'; R1 范围 read-only, 与 freeze 一致; R1 完成后 6 dimensions non-zero → 重新评估
12h **不** has 真实 quote/fee/EV (条件不满足); 24h 跑出来**仍** r0 proxy (因 r0 collector 不改); 24h 浪费 compute (2x smoke_placeholder)
Base public RPC 仍 403 (env unchanged); Paid RPC blocked by freeze; env change **不** 在本 stage 范围; 即便 Base 修好仍 r0 phase
valid option, but R1 升级是**更** productive next step; 暂停 = 等 freeze reopen 或 Base fix, 但**不**解决 r0 → r1 升级

recommended_next_stage_rationale: 12h 仍 r0 proxy (per fee_estimation_review + candidate_review_audit); spec 明确 '如果当前 12h 主要仍是 R0 proxy / smoke_placeholder: 推荐 R1'; R1 范围 read-only, 与 freeze 一致; R1 完成后 6 dimensions non-zero → 重新评估 preflight/watchlist/data_insufficient; R1 不**不** mint / **不** freeze reopen / **不** actual fee → **不** 触发 freeze

r1_required_steps_before_launch.name: 新 scope freeze
r1_required_steps_before_launch.value: coverage_scope=partial_solana_bsc_real_universe_r1 + r1_objectives=[real_rpc, real_quote, real_volume, real_regime, real_liquidity_distribution, actual_fee_schema_unchanged]

r1_required_steps_before_launch.name: 新 r1 collector + adapters 升级
新 r1 启动 via nohup

r1_completion_next_stage.condition: R1 12h PASS, data_insufficient ≤ 10, preflight > 0, watchlist > 0, fee_proxy_only=false
R1 12h PASS, data_insufficient > 10, RPC reachability blocker
R1 12h PASS, freeze 仍 active, no actual fee data

absolute_prohibitions: 不启动 24h / 48h / 72h / 7d (per spec 规则 + 12h 仍 r0)
不读 wallet / seed / keypair / signer
不发送 transaction / approve / mint / swap / bridge
不覆盖 shadow 原始表
不接 paid RPC / paid indexer
不 mint 实际 LP NFT 仓位 (R1 仅升级 data layer, **不** mint)
